title: Central American Lines Of Business (v2.9)
text:
Central American Lines Of Business (v2.9)

LOB codes for select Central American countries supported by 
UNICEDE
/2.

These codes are valid when using 
UNICEDE
/2 for exposures in the following countries:
 Belize, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, and Panama.

Standard Lines of Business

| Code | Lines of Business |
| --- | --- |
| HSHB | Household Building |
| HSHC | Household Contents |
| FAL | Fire & Allied Lines |
| ENG | Engineering |
| AUTO | Auto |

Market Share Lines of Business

| Code | Lines of Business |
| --- | --- |
| BLD | Residential Building |
| CNT | Residential Contents |
| COM | Commercial |
| AUTO | Auto |
